services.desc: How long are your classes and what time do they start? We offer three 2-hour classes every day except Mondays, starting at 11:00 am, 1:30 pm, and 4:00 pm.Our All Day Zen Session gives you up to seven hours of weaving in a single day, from 11:00 am to 6:00 pm.The Kids Fiber Arts Club meets weekly during the school term

services.name: Package
services.desc: Whether you want to create an artistic tapestry or make garments from your own handwoven cloth, your project possibilities are endless. We offer packages in 4, 8 and 12 session quantities. Advanced packages have no fixed curriculum and are tailored to your individual learning goals and creative objectives. For example, if you want to make a table runner to fit your table or a garment that suits your body, you will receive individual consultation and guidance to customize your warp size and color. Multiple projects may be completed within your chosen package.During the package period, we will store your work at the studio, and you can freely schedule your classes online using the code
